title: Why Do Companies Switch From Google Workspace To Microsoft 365? - BGR
summary: Although both Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace offer security features, Workspace's features may be too basic for some businesses, causing them to make a switch. Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 have subscription costs associated with their business tiers.
